_why: Module 11 deep-dive checks (labs/m11/deep-dive.checks.json), REAL. Object state only, read at the deep dive's end, after its last section and before its teardown.
State-tolerant: the deep dive creates or re-applies everything it reads in agent-probes, so these hold whether or not the lab ran first.

checks.describe: probe-sandbox's Pod carries an ownerReferences entry of kind Sandbox with controller: true: the Agent Sandbox controller created it and owns it, so deleting the Sandbox deletes the Pod. No owner prints owner=none
checks.run: KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-sandbox.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-sandbox -n agent-probes get pod probe-sandbox -o json | jq -r '[.metadata.ownerReferences[]? | select(.kind == "Sandbox")] | if length == 0 then "owner=none controller=none" else "owner=Sandbox controller=" + ((.[0].controller // false) | tostring) end'

checks.describe: Sandbox reap-demo and its Pod are both gone after spec.shutdownTime passed under shutdownPolicy Delete, and the namespace still holds the reaped Pod's events, so an absence on a cluster where reap-demo never existed does not pass. An unreachable cluster prints namespace=unread
checks.run: ns=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-sandbox.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-sandbox get namespace agent-probes -o name 2>/dev/null); [ "$ns" = "namespace/agent-probes" ] || { echo namespace=unread; exit 0; }; s=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-sandbox.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-sandbox -n agent-probes get sandbox reap-demo -o name --ignore-not-found); p=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-sandbox.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-sandbox -n agent-probes get pod reap-demo -o name --ignore-not-found); e=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-sandbox.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-sandbox -n agent-probes get events -o json | jq -r '[.items[] | select(.involvedObject.name == "reap-demo")] | length'); [ -n "$s" ] && s=present || s=absent; [ -n "$p" ] && p=present || p=absent; [ "${e:-0}" -gt 0 ] && h=seen || h=none; printf 'sandbox=%s pod=%s history=%s\n' "$s" "$p" "$h"

checks.describe: ClusterTrustBundle m11-demo-bundle exists, and Pod ctb-reader's spec projects it through a clusterTrustBundle volume source. Object state; the PEM read back from inside the Pod is the page's evidence
checks.run: b=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-sandbox.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-sandbox get clustertrustbundle m11-demo-bundle -o name --ignore-not-found); j=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-sandbox.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-sandbox -n agent-probes get pod ctb-reader -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '[.spec.volumes[]?.projected.sources[]?.clusterTrustBundle.name // empty] | index("m11-demo-bundle") != null'); [ -n "$b" ] && b=present || b=absent; [ "$j" = "true" ] && j=yes || j=no; printf 'bundle=%s projected=%s\n' "$b" "$j"
